Overview

Capiatá is a city in CE with a population of 200,000. A rapidly growing suburb of Asunción, a residential area with a strong community identity. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 27.0.
